name: create_challenge
description: Create a challenge within a circle. Infer tracking method, target value, duration, and rules from the user's description. Always add a description with rules.

description.description: Challenge rules and details. Be specific about what counts as completion.

trackingMethod.description: How progress is tracked: tasks_completed (count tasks done), focus_minutes (total focus time), active_days (days with activity), proof_checkin (manual daily check-in)

targetValue.description: Goal value to reach (e.g. 50 tasks, 500 minutes, 14 days). Must be a positive integer.

durationDays.description: Challenge duration in days. Common: 7, 14, 30. Default 7.
